description: Generated multi-turn refactor session: user constraints early, a goal, a todo list, file writes and edits, a failing test run inside a long log, and a failed edit cell.

items.text: Don't change the public signature of `Config::load`.
Never run `cargo update`; the lockfile is pinned for the 2.4 release.
Always run `cargo test -p config-core` before you say something is done.
Only touch files under crates/config-core/ — the CLI crate is owned by another team.
Also, prefer returning `ConfigError::Duplicate { key, line }` rather than panicking.
fs-edit: old text not found in crates/config-core/src/validate.rs
Split config-core parsing into RawConfig + validation without changing Config::load

followUps.question: Which command must pass before you may report the work as done?
May you run `cargo update` in this repository? Answer yes or no and say why.
Which directory are you allowed to edit?
Which test is failing right now, and with what message?
Which TOML library did we decide to keep?
What should a duplicate key produce instead of a panic?
